knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    collapse: true
    comment: "#>"
    echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

use("tidywigits", c("WIGITS_TOOLS", "WIGITS_TOOL_COLOURS"))
use("nemo", "nemo_schema_reactable")
```

One row per schema table. A file that fans out is followed by its output tables;
expand a row for its columns and, for an output, its file table.

```{r}
#| label: reactable

nemo_schema_reactable(
  names(WIGITS_TOOLS),
  pkg = "tidywigits",
  tool_colours = WIGITS_TOOL_COLOURS
)
```
